prompt:
Create ONE original transparent PNG sprite atlas of EMPTY WEARABLE GARMENT COMPONENTS for ASHVEIL, a worn low-fantasy pixel-art RPG. These are ordinary unworn clothing objects for modular paper-doll animation. There is NO PERSON inside any object: no wearer, mannequin, body, skin, limb, hand, foot, anatomy, weapon, injury, blood or gore. Cloth, leather, knit wool and iron mail only. Preserve open dark fabric-lined cuffs and empty hollow garment openings.

Use ONLY the two supplied OWN ASHVEIL reference images. Reference 1 is useful ONLY for its four row facings, low elevated RPG viewpoint, neutral vertically hanging component axes and muted art family; DO NOT copy its human heads, torsos, arms, legs, hands, feet or skin into this new image. Reference 2 supplies the project's own worn apparel palette, hard pixel-cluster textile/leather/mail materials, stitching and quiet outline. Do not copy whole coats, armor torsos, paired boots, inventory tools or any other reference objects. Draw the requested isolated new garment pieces.

EXACT LAYOUT: ONE wide 1536 by 1024 RGBA canvas, EIGHT equal columns by FOUR equal rows, exactly THIRTY-TWO isolated complete objects. Nominal cells are192 by256 pixels. Broad truly transparent gutters and outer margins. Center one object in each cell, each object around55percent of its cell height and normally below45percent of cell width. Keep the sleeves' long axis vertical, top attachment end above, distal cuff below, neutrally hanging like the reference animation parts. No rotated diagonal inventory pose. Keep every whole object inside its own cell. No grid, labels, lettering, numbers, facing arrows, palette swatches, floor, ground shadow, fog, glow, backdrop, watermark, extra views or assembled character.

ROWS, TOP TO BOTTOM, are independently drawn semantic garment views of FRONT / LEFT / RIGHT / BACK, following the reference's row order. FRONT: material front surfaces face the viewer. LEFT: garment outer side surfaces are drawn for a wearer facing screen-left; the single boot's toe points screen-left. RIGHT: genuine opposing side view for a wearer facing screen-right; the single boot's toe points screen-right. BACK: rear seams/back surfaces and boot heel toward viewer, no front toe panel masquerading as a rear view. Do not use a pasted front row as the back. These are graphic facings only: there is ONE generic glove and ONE generic boot in each facing, and neither owns a specific anatomical left/right limb. Do not put a pair in one cell.

COLUMNS LEFT TO RIGHT, repeat this exact order in all FOUR rows:
1. LINEN SHORT UPPER SLEEVE ONLY: ash-beige worn linen shoulder-to-above-elbow sleeve piece, rounded shoulder attachment cap/seam at top, loose short open hem at bottom, readable woven creases and frayed stitching. No bodice, torso, collar, forearm extension or skin.
2. WORN LEATHER UPPER SLEEVE ONLY: dull brown separate short shoulder-to-elbow leather sleeve, overlapping stitched panels, shoulder attachment arc at top, open elbow hem below. No cuirass, torso plate, elbow flesh, forearm or hand.
3. IRON MAIL UPPER SLEEVE ONLY: flexible short upper-arm sleeve made of dark small iron rings over a dark lining, curved shoulder attachment at top, slight tapered open elbow cuff below. Mail reads as linked metal, not scales, a solid mechanical arm, glowing armor or a human arm.
4. PADDED-CLOTH FOREARM SLEEVE ONLY: separate neutral grey-umber quilted elbow-to-wrist cloth tube, broad open elbow attachment at top, narrower bound open wrist cuff below. Visible stitched quilting and soft seam folds; no upper arm, glove or skin.
5. LEATHER FOREARM SLEEVE ONLY: separate dull brown stitched elbow-to-wrist leather tube/bracer-sleeve, open broad proximal cuff above, narrowed open wrist cuff below, restrained lacing or strap seams. No armored hand, upper arm or skin.
6. ONE EMPTY LEATHER GLOVE: wrist cuff opening at top, relaxed fingers pointing downward, one thumb-shaped leather pocket on the appropriate graphic surface, actual leather panels and finger seams, hollow cloth-lined cuff. A glove object, not a bare hand, not a skin-colored hand, no forearm, weapon or second glove. One generic side per facing; no anatomical ownership claim.
7. ONE EMPTY WOOL MITTEN/GLOVE: dull grey-brown thick knitted wool glove/mitten with ribbed open wrist cuff at top, thumb pouch and soft padded finger area downward, visible small knit clusters. Empty wearable object only, no forearm, skin, second glove or metal plate. One generic side per facing.
8. ONE EMPTY ANKLE-HIGH LEATHER BOOT: short scuffed brown leather ankle shaft with a dark empty top opening, stitched upper, small tied laces, worn dark sole and heel. No leg/shin/knee/skin. Front view toe faces toward the viewer; LEFT row toe points screen-left; RIGHT row toe points screen-right; BACK shows heel/rear seam toward viewer. Exactly one boot per cell, not a pair.

All32 objects must be wholly garment material. Openings show dark fabric/leather lining and transparency beyond, never flesh-colored plugs. Muted charcoal, ash-linen, dry umber, grey wool and weathered iron; small deliberate hard-edged pixel clusters, narrow upper-left light planes, clear material differences. No glossy plastic, photoreal product photography, smeared brush gradients, neon, ornate magic symbols or checkerboard painted into the PNG. True transparency between every isolated component. No cropped tips or cuffs. Render the complete32-object atlas once.
